capabilities: Resolve broken embeds by filename from a list of external folders
Render external media with Obsidian sizing suffixes and per-link alignment
Index external folders and their subfolders for faster lookups
Rescan the current view and rebuild the external folder index
Mark externally-resolved embeds with an optional dashed outline
disambiguation: Does not move or manage attachments itself; you cut files out of the vault manually and the plugin only resolves their embeds afterward.
extras: Desktop only — mobile Obsidian does not expose the local filesystem. Not yet in the community catalog; install via BRAT or manually from a release. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Externally-resolved embeds avoid Obsidian's standard embed CSS classes, so themes like Minimal style them differently unless you add your own snippet.
motivation: The author built it because no existing tool resolved embeds from outside the vault, leaving users to delete their files or pay for more storage.
problem: Obsidian only resolves embeds for files inside the vault, so moving large attachments out to dodge sync quotas breaks every wikilink pointing at them.

relations.evidence: install with BRAT pointed at this repo

requires.name: cloud sync clients (Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.)

summary: Embed resolver that renders attachment embeds from folders outside the vault, so heavy files can live on external drives or extra cloud storage.
